facts.business: The company is engaged in the manufacturing of oil country tubular goods (OCTG) such as casing, tubing, and drill pipes for the oil and gas industry.
key_risks: Increase in loss incurred during the year
Significant decline in sales/income from operations
Negative profit margins and return ratios
High variance in key financial ratios (Debt Service Coverage Ratio, Trade Receivables turnover, Net profit ratio)
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions were on an arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with potential conflict of interest. Transactions are periodically placed before the Audit Committee for omnibus approval. Policy available at www.octlindia.com.
